text:
miriam: Heads-up: we're seeing a spike in SCIM deprovisions and some SSO fails after last night's key alias swap. KMS errors in provisioner logs. Anyone on?

kartik: I'm here. Sample log: 
2026-07-14T02:12:10Z provisioner ERROR tenant=zenpay scim=deprov kms_err=EnvelopeHeaderMismatch expected_kid=key/oldX got=key/newY

ryan: EnvelopeHeaderMismatch usually means cached envelopes weren't rewrapped before alias swap. Did ops run the rewrap job?

olivia: We started it but the lambda timed out. Alias swap completed at 02:00 UTC.

miriam: That would explain decrypt failures. Also saw some NameID lookup misses in SSO logs around the same time. Any RBAC mapping changes deployed?

kartik: There was an RBAC prune yesterday that changed SAML NameID mapping from email->persistent for privacy reasons. Could cause false user resolution misses.

devsec-bot: ALERT scim-deprov-spike severity=high tenants=11 events=289 incident=INC-2026-451 created_by=devsec-bot

ryan: Twofold failure vector then: 1) KMS alias swap without rewrap causing decrypt errors; 2) NameID mapping change causing lookup misses -> deprov.

olivia: Immediate mitigation: flip SCIM to deferred mode (ACK and queue) for affected regions to avoid destructive deprovs. I can do eu-west and ap-southeast now.

miriam: Do it. Kartik, can you re-run rewrap with higher timeout and lower concurrency? Snapshot envelopes first.

kartik: Will snapshot redis keys to s3://secure/envelopes/incident-2112345678/ then run idempotent rewrap lambda with timeout=15m concurrency=5 and format detection (v1/v2).

ryan: I'll own audit backfill planning. We need Compliance sign-off. Backfilled audit rows must be labeled "backfilled_due_kms" and reference the incident.

olivia: Deferred mode active for eu-west and ap-southeast. Queue length rising but no deprovs.

miriam: Also add a transient NameID shim in the IdP to accept legacy email format for 48h to reduce lookup misses.

kartik: Adding shim now. Rewrap dry-run on 50 envelopes succeeded: 50/50. Starting tenant batches.

devsec-bot: NOTE incident INC-2026-451 state=mitigating owners=[olivia,kartik,ryan,miriam] sla=72h

ryan: After first rewrap batch, I'll replay a small set of queued events and validate audit insertion. Need to ensure we preserve original timestamps and include backfill metadata.

miriam: Good. Postmortem items: enforce pre-rotation checklist (snapshot+rewrap test+maintenance-mode), harden rewrap lambda, and gate RBAC changes when key/IdP rotations in-flight.

kartik: Rewrap progress: rewrapped=180/1200, no decrypt errors for processed tenants. ETA ~3h. Posting logs to INC-2026-451.

olivia: Preparing short customer blurb for affected tenants once we have backfill ETA.

miriam: Thanks. Keep updates here. If any tenant is unaffected despite rotation, flag it - could indicate envelope format differences.
